svg.title: Figure 1. The Internet Transparency Stack
svg.desc: Seven layers read from the bottom up. Foundation, framework, presentation, record, evidence, treaty and enforcement. A dashed line connects the record at layer four to the treaty at layer six, marking the gap that the evidence layer at five closes.

g.text: Enforcement. Treaty and legal obligations made operational for digital environments
Convention 108, with Convention 108+ and CETS 225 pending
Treaty. Cross border transparency and AI governance obligations
Evidence. Machine readable proof of disclosure, authority and rights context
Record. Consent record and receipt information structure
Presentation. Online privacy notice and consent content and structure
Framework. Technology neutral privacy framework, terminology, actors and roles
Foundation. Notice and awareness principles, carried by every instrument since
The dashed line marks the connection between the record at layer 4 and the treaty at layer 6,
which is the gap that layer 5 closes. Read the stack from the bottom up.
